takeaways.text: Revenue rose to $7.75B from $4.01B a year ago, on record data center revenue — robust AI demand drove a strong ramp of data center DRAM and high-bandwidth memory, and data center SSD sales passed $1B in a quarter for the first time.
takeaways.title: Revenue nearly doubled

takeaways.text: Gross margin reached 35%, up from -11% a year ago when Micron was still digging out of a memory glut — tighter supply and AI pricing turned each sale profitable again. Full-year revenue was $25.1B.
takeaways.title: Margins swung back

takeaways.text: Net income of $887M, versus a $1.43B loss a year ago; non-GAAP net income was $1.34B. Micron guided the next quarter's revenue to $8.7B — another record.
takeaways.title: Profit is back

verdict: Micron's revenue nearly doubled in a year to $7.75B as AI demand for data-center memory boomed — gross margin swung from -11% to 35%, and the company earned $887M after losing $1.4B in the same quarter a year earlier.
